consent.body: A 12-minute study on how students judge their own DSA skill.

report.title: Your results
report.about: We are testing whether platform numbers alone give students an accurate picture of their skill, and whether short topic feedback helps. You were randomly placed in one of two groups: one saw only numbers, the other also saw topic tips. All feedback came from your real answers.
report.withdrawn: Your data will be removed. Thank you.
